flavor.text: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.
This Pokémon lives in areas of frigid cold. It secures itself to the back of an Avalugg by freezing its feet in place.
They chill the air around them to −150 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing the water in the air into ice that they use as armor.
Using air of -150 degrees Fahrenheit, they freeze opponents solid. They live in herds above the snow line on mountains.
It blocks opponents’ attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.

abilities.name: Own Tempo
abilities.description: The Pokémon sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused or being affected by Intimidate.

abilities.name: Ice Body
abilities.description: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in snow.

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.description: The Pokémon cannot be knocked out by a single hit as long as its HP is full. One-hit KO moves will also fail to knock it out.
